commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.learned_history_observability_probe --env-config configs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile.json --episodes 40 --seed 9380 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 1000 --history-window 50 --device cpu --epochs 30 --hidden-size 24 --weight-decay 0.001 --profile-set ablation --run-dir runs/m91i_learned_history_sensor_ablation_seed9380
commands.name: learned_history_sensor_ablation

decision_rule: Identify which deployable response channels explain M91-H's history benefit before PPO or optional sensor expansion.
failure_criteria: ablation profiles are not matched by seed and target
ablation removes future information incorrectly or changes scene context
no channel group explains the history benefit
results are used as promoted policy evidence
hypothesis: The repeatable history benefit is driven by body response and command/actuator dynamics, while raw wheel speed mainly helps lateral-response prediction.
success_criteria: P0/P1 and ablated response-channel groups are evaluated with the same learned probe recipe
at least one channel group explains the history benefit on yaw or lateral response
decision states whether to proceed to PPO profile comparison or corpus redesign
